name: XR: Virtual-, Mixed-, and Augmented Reality
description:
Lecture Contents (among others): 
•	State of the Art Taxonomy and Perspectives of Real-time Interactive XR Systems
•	Immersion and Presence, Explicated
•	Avatars, Virtual Embodiment 
•	Cognitive Effects of XR (e.g. Proteus Effect)
•	Multi-User, Asymmetric, Collaborative and Social XR
•	Advanced 3DUI
•	Advanced Visualization Strategies
•	Cross-Reality (Asymmetric XR)
•	Environment Reconstruction for XR
•	Metaverse
•	Empirical Research Practices in XR
•	Training and Teaching
•	XR 4 Good, Mental and Physical Health
•	All Sorts of Senses - (Exotic) Inputs and Displays

Exercise Contents (Among others):
•	Unity3D Introduction/Recap
•	Mixed Reality Toolkit
•	Advanced 3D Interaction
•	Digital Characters and Avatars
•	Networking & Synchronization
•	Study Participation/Project Exploration
prerequisites: The course teaches subsequent content to the courses [IN2018] Augmented Reality or [IN2293] Medical Augmented Reality and therefore foundational knowledge is required. Students must have successfully completed either [IN2018] Augmented Reality or [IN2293] Medical Augmented Reality. A successful completion of [IN2111] 3D User Interfaces is recommended.
